fourier_normalization_operator_compariso.Fourier normalization_central_action: rho(-I_6)=-R; on the certified even spaces it is -I
fourier_normalization_operator_compariso.Fourier normalization_identity: hat-hat=1331 R and F=11^(-3/2)hat; on the certified even restrictions F^2=I
fourier_normalization_operator_compariso.Hadamard degeneration_identity: H H^T=H^T H=12I; reduction at 3 gives the exact alternating H/H^T complex
fourier_normalization_operator_compariso.common_exact_pattern: an unnormalized integral/cyclotomic transform becomes an isometry only after division by the square root of its orthogonality scalar
fourier_normalization_operator_compariso.discriminator: H supplies no SL_2(11) action or central scalar; rank six and Fourier-style normalization cannot override Fourier normalization/mod-three Weil--Golay's central-character obstruction
fourier_normalization_operator_compariso.valuation_discriminator: Hadamard degeneration has v_3(12)=1, so the divided inverse survives; Fourier normalization has v_11(1331)=3, so the simple-bad-prime exactness lemma does not transfer

witt_code_carrier_identification.orientation_warning: the Witt code code is ker(H)=im(H^T); ker(H^T)=im(H) is the distinct transpose companion in the frozen coordinates

golay_hadamard_carrier_geometry.equivariance_statement: Golay--Hadamard's signed coordinate and Hadamard-row lifts preserve the integral pairing H; equivalently R H^T=H^T M and H R^T=M^T H for each recorded standard generator
golay_hadamard_carrier_geometry.exact_complex_interpretation: H and H^T alternate between Golay--Hadamard's two labelled 12-spaces; the distinct transpose carrier is expected in frozen coordinates and is exchanged by row/column duality
golay_hadamard_carrier_geometry.imported_fact: Golay--Hadamard identifies the coordinate and Hadamard-row carriers as the two outer-related degree-12 M12 actions, with frozen PSL_2(11) as the base-cell stabilizer
golay_hadamard_carrier_geometry.signed_six_dimensional_transport: the divided Bocksteins are equivariant: beta_H intertwines ker(H),R^T with coker(H),M^T, and beta_Ht intertwines ker(H^T),M with coker(H^T),R

integral_matrix_factorization.block_formula: H=[[1^T,1],[J-2A,-1]] in the frozen Witt code row/coordinate orders
integral_matrix_factorization.bridge_formula: modulo 3, each lower Hadamard row minus the top row is the parity extension of the corresponding Witt code incidence row
integral_matrix_factorization.normalization: 12^(-1/2) H is an isometry between the two labelled 12-spaces

smith_normal_form.proof: H^T=12H^{-1} has the same Smith factors as H, hence d_i*d_(13-i)=12; rank mod 2 is 1, rank mod 3 is 6, and divisibility determines the displayed list

mod_3_exact_complex.determinant_cross_check: im(H^T) is isotropic so rank(H)<=6, while v_3(det H)=v_3(12^6)=6 forces nullity(H)<=6

divided_Bockstein.formula: beta_H(x)=[Hx/3] in F_3^12/im(H); H^T beta_H(x)=4x=x, and similarly with H,H^T exchanged
divided_Bockstein.integral_cokernel_interpretation: ker(H mod 3)=Tor_1(coker(H),F_3), while coker(H) tensor F_3=coker(H mod 3); the divided Bockstein canonically identifies these two six-dimensional shadows
divided_Bockstein.meaning: the divided integral operator is a canonical inverse to the induced differential, not merely a rank witness

general_simple_bad_prime_lemma.proof: for Ax=0 mod p, set y=Ax/p; then By=u*x mod p, and multiply by u^{-1}; exchange A and B for the other differential
general_simple_bad_prime_lemma.statement: if integral square matrices A,B satisfy AB=BA=p*u*I with p prime and u nonzero mod p, then reduction mod p gives an exact two-periodic A/B complex

mod_3_exact_complex.structural_proof: if Hx=0 mod 3, then y=Hx/3 is integral and H^T y=4x=x mod 3; transpose the argument for H^T

puncture_shorten_bridge.shortening_condition: last coordinate zero, equivalently sum of punctured coordinates zero
